parameters.name: DestinationEndpointRegion
parameters.description:
The region ID of the destination instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
> If the destination instance is a self-managed database that has a public IP address, you can specify **ap-southeast-1** or the region ID that is geographically closest to the self-managed database.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS task instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SourceEndpointRegion
parameters.description:
The region ID of the source instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
> If the source instance is a self-managed database that has a public IP address, you can specify **ap-southeast-1** or the region ID that is geographically closest to the self-managed database.
